scope: Unchanged SESU 3.0.7 MultiPlatformUpdate revocation traversal (RVA 0x39FC), final metadata validator (RVA 0x37E0) and X509Chain policy on owned Mono 6.12 over fresh synthetic certificates. Synthetic anchors were added only to in-memory WhiteListCert maps; Windows CryptoAPI was not run.

anchors.pin_rule: exact uppercase SHA-1 thumbprint key and uppercase GetPublicKeyString value (RSA PKCS1 public key); no dates, store or signature

traversal: fetch/cached rv1 list for the current certificate thumbprint
validate JWT (x5t key, RS256, lifetime, 300 s skew) and payload_sha256 over the list with $.signatures excluded
require the rv1 signer to match a revocation-signer pin
union revokedSignatures and revokedCertificates (default ordinal HashSet<string>)
fail if any certificate traversed so far is listed
stop successfully at a pinned root
resolve the issuer by IssuerName.Name through the subject cache or server
final_validator: verify node v1 JWT and digest
fail if the node token is in the accumulated revoked signatures
X509Chain.Build(leaf) with RevocationMode.NoCheck, VerificationFlags.AllowUnknownCertificateAuthority and the traversed certificates in ExtraStore
any exception logs a warning and IsMetadataValidated=false
static_policy.revocation_consumption: Signed rv1 lists are the only revocation source: Windows CRL/OCSP is disabled (NoCheck). Lists for every traversed certificate are unioned; revoked certificates are matched to uppercase thumbprints by ordinal equality; revoked node tokens by exact string. List id is not compared with the requested thumbprint.

expiry_handling.chain_certificates: Only X509Chain.Build checks validity (NotTimeValid is not ignored), at the chain default DateTime.Now; JWT signing keys are RsaSecurityKey without certificate-date checks.
expiry_handling.revocation_signer_certificate: Never date-checked; only the pin applies.
expiry_handling.rv1_and_v1_tokens: Lifetime validated with the IdentityModel 300-second skew.

toolkit_application_certificates.conclusion: Not SESU update anchors: no SESU assembly references them and their keys match no WhiteListCert pin.
